alerts.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued November 26 at 12:20PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
alerts.desc: A large and long period westerly swell will produce a risk of breaking waves in the Morro Bay and Ventura Harbor entrances through this evening. These conditions have a history of capsizing vessels of various sizes resulting in serious injury or death, even to the most experienced mariners. Mariners are urged to stay clear of these harbor entrances during the time mentioned. For more information, contact the local harbor patrol or coast guard station and continue to monitor NOAA Weather Radio for the latest weather information.
